summary: Curved main road kerb with houses right at the edge and no parked cars.

best_section.where: west kerb just south of the junction at the northern bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit within about 6-15 m of the kerb along the whole west side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with a narrow footpath verge; no pull-off or shoulder beside the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Through route with lane markings and moving traffic; no parked cars seen on the kerb.
drivers.convention: No signs and no parking convention visible on this kerb.

flags: House 6 m from kerb at the south end
sun_shade: Open on the west kerb; golf-course trees shade the road from the east in the morning.
